a signed-in member cannot reserve (refused by the database)
a signed-in member cannot complete or refund (refused by the database)
a signed-in member cannot call the number helper
an anonymous caller cannot reserve (refused by the database)
an anonymous caller cannot complete or refund (refused by the database)
an anonymous caller cannot call the number helper
a signed-in member cannot read the reservation table
(pre-existing) a member's own consume_bulk_scan still cannot move the counter
reserve one scan: allowance 5, 1 used (a provider call would now be 'in flight')
during the in-flight reservation the member's direct refund, completion and re-reservation are all refused
the reservation and the counter are untouched by those attempts and by direct edits (still reserved, still 1 used)
the server then completes it: scan stays spent
a finished scan cannot be refunded afterwards (even by the server)
completing twice changes nothing
a repeated request id spends once (reserved, then duplicate; 1 used)
10 identical requests at the same instant: exactly one reserved, nine duplicates, 1 used
14 different requests at the same instant against an allowance of 3: exactly 3 reserved, 11 refused as over the limit, counter 3
two requests racing for the one scan left, 6 rounds: exactly one wins every time
provider failed: 8 refunds at the same instant give the scan back exactly once (counter 0, all answers 'released')
the released request id can be retried and is charged once (1 used)
refunding a request the server never reserved does nothing
setup: a lapsed cycle (started 2020-01-01) with 4 used
a member's status read of the lapsed cycle answers with the NEW cycle and 0 used
and writes NOTHING: the stored row is exactly as it was (4 used, old cycle), so nothing can be carried over by a read
the server's next reservation rolls the cycle: 1 used in the new cycle (the old 4 are NOT carried over)
a refund for a reservation taken in an OLDER cycle changes nothing in the current one (released, counter unchanged)
an anonymous caller cannot read the allowance status
